name: ONEGLOVE
recent: 公司于2026年9月7日召开第24届常年股东大会，所有议案均获通过。同期董事局出现变动，Dominic Aw Kian-Wee 卸任，公司秘书也发生更换。此外，大股东 ADA Capital Investments Limited 与董事 Low Bok Tek 的持股出现变动，涉及可赎回可转换优先股（RCPS）转换为普通股。
notable: 第24届常年股东大会于2026年9月7日举行，所有议案获股东通过。
Dominic Aw Kian-Wee 卸任董事职务。
Low Bok Tek 将1,900万股 RCPS 转换为普通股，新股于2025年9月19日上市。
risks: 董事 Low Bok Tek 及大股东 ADA Capital Investments Limited 的持股出现变动。
RCPS 转换为普通股导致已发行股本增加，可能摊薄现有股东权益。

recent_en: The company held its 24th AGM on 7 September 2026, with all resolutions passed. During the same period, there was a boardroom change with Dominic Aw Kian-Wee stepping down, and a change of company secretary. In addition, there were changes in the shareholdings of substantial shareholder ADA Capital Investments Limited and Director Low Bok Tek, involving the conversion of Redeemable Convertible Preference Shares (RCPS) into ordinary shares.
notable_en: The 24th AGM was held on 7 September 2026, with all resolutions passed by shareholders.
Dominic Aw Kian-Wee stepped down from the board.
Low Bok Tek converted 19 million RCPS into ordinary shares, with the new shares listed on 19 September 2025.
risks_en: There were changes in the shareholdings of Director Low Bok Tek and substantial shareholder ADA Capital Investments Limited.
The conversion of RCPS into ordinary shares increased the issued share capital and may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
